notes.title: Update 2018-09-14
notes.content:
This update includes the followings:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[b]Explorer's Sentry Camp[/b]

Now you can discover a Sentry Camp installed by Explorer's guild.
Explorer's Sentry Camp provides benefits as following:

[list]
[*]The camp has a high probability of having a merchant.
[*]Somtimes, it has a treasure noticeboard.
[/list]

Since you find any Sentry Camp, you can start the game from there after you are exhausted. The Sentry Camp is available to use until you encounter another Sentry Camp or you visit the Base Camp.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The player character doesn't approach to the target when it's trying to attack the character in range crossing the fences.
[*] A NPC doesn't play die animation when it's killed by an explosion and is lifted at the same time.
[*] The player character can lift an object or NPC when it's lifting another.
[*] When more than one relic is on the 3rd phase of the relic challenge and having the candidate rooms overlapping, only a room count whether the player character passes the place or not when the other doesn't.
[*] Since the player collects all three relics and continues to play for the second time, the player cannot obtain any exploration points before restarting the game.
[*] The candidate rooms in the 3rd phase of the relic challenge include the region where the player visited once already.
[*] Cannot change the toggle asking whether to send the player's information or not.
[*] Quest retry sequence is played more than once when the player character is exhausted, and the quest target object is destroyed immediately after that.
[*] The perception sight of an NPC doesn't show up when it is frozen when the player character sneaks on.
[*] The chasing NPCs overlap each other entering the room.
[*] When an NPC, which is hostile to the player, attacks the player character, it stops attacking motion after one another.
[*] The player character cannot receive a quest if the player resets the situation right after he/she find the place in the 3rd phase of the relic challenge.
[*] The player character can accept the quest right after the quest is completed.
[*] A chasing NPC is still in chasing state even when the player came back to the room where the NPC begins tracking the player.
[*] The location where the relic is collected is displayed in English even when the Korean language is selected.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2018-08-31
notes.content:
This update includes the followings:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

Improved quest completion effects: we used minimum visual effects to encourage faster exploration, but explorers suffered from unexpected invisible (locked) doors. Now you can see the passage to the next area during quest completion.

Added 3 Mushroom Leaders to snowy fields and ruins:
 * Nutritious Mushroom Leader: Non-liftable, more HP, melee damage reduction & resistance(%)
 * Fire Mushroom Leader: Non-liftable, more HP, Fire damage reduction & resistance(%)
 * Frost Mushroom Leader: Non-liftable, more HP, Frost damage reduction & resistance(%)

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

A creature didn’t act as assigned AI script when 1) a creature traced a player character, dance because of a campfire, and then moved to the next area by the player character, or 2) a player character encountered with the hostile creature and move to the next area.

A quest didn’t fail, when 1) a creature lifted the quest target item and fled to the next area, or 2) the quest target item was destroyed.

The client thumbnail on Main Menu didn’t disappear, even though the quest was completed.

Two Main Menu buttons are displayed at the same time when a player has begun a treasure challenge and opened and closed Maps.

A skeleton kept trying to attack from ambush infinitely when a player sneaked and attacked the ambushed skeleton.


A creature kept being beaten in the first place, moving to other direction and then attacking when it attacked.

A creature kept dancing when the creature liked(hearted) a player character, even though the player character carried a treasure.

The game screen was displayed weird when Main Menu was opened.

A creature was able to interact with an object in distance.

A faction’s faction level didn’t get lowered, even though a player character sneaked and assassinated the faction’s member, and got caught.


Nothing was displayed on Main Menu, even though Treasure Challenge was begun during a quest.

The volume of sound effect extremely increased, when a player kept clicking a learned skill and the OK button on it.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

When a player open Mailbox as soon as he/she completes a quest, the quest still exists and is able to be accepted. Please open Mailbox and accept one of the other quests after quest completion effect is done while we’re working the fix.

notes.title: Update 2018-08-17
notes.content:
This update includes the followings:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

* When the status of a relic is changed, the relic notification(purple) will be displayed to inform what to do.

* Captions are added to the icons in the context and main menu. Now you can see what each icon means and their hotkeys when you put your mouse over the icons.

* Mushrooms are weakened. We've heard Mushrooms are too strong unlike their looks from our explorers frequently. So, we modified Mushroom's hit points, damage, speed and sight a bit.

* Along the mushrooms, some other creatures' data are modified:

 - Weakened creatures: Mist Wolf, Snow Wolf, Forest Wolf Leader, Snow Skeleton, Giant Forest Skeleton, Treant, Giant Treant

 - Strengthened creatures: Snow Wolf Leader, Mist Skeleton, Giant Snow Skeleton

(Mushrooms' leader is one its way. It would have more power than an ordinary one. We'll inform you when it's ready. Stay tuned!)

* New items are added: Shining Scimitar, Shining Recurve Bow, Improved Explorer's Outfit. You can buy them from human merchants.

* Some items' price has been modified: Considerably Reinforced Scimitar, Considerably Reinforced Recurve Bow, Cutting Edge Explorer’s Outfit

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[Trade] failed to sell and unable to return to Trade screen when a player clicked Sell button in the Trade screen.
[Trap] the collision box disappeared a bit later when a trap was disarmed.
[Sneak] Sneak speed was not improved even though the player character learned Sneak Lv. 3.
[Frost] Frost spell was cast twice under certain circumstances
[Relics] Relic screen was overlapped with Maps screen.
[Present] The item list disappeared when a player clicked an item at the bottom in the Present screen
[Main Menu] Aero glass effect disappeared when a player opened one of Main Menu screens and minimized the game client.
[Quest] Can proceed a quest, even though the treasure was destroyed in the first quest.
[Pickpocket] Action points were not consumed when a player character tried to plant(Pickpocket Lv 5).
[Navigator] Navigator disappeared when a player restarted the game client during a quest
[Emoji] NPCs didn’t show treasure emojis for unknown reasons.

notes.title: Fantasy Raiders Release Announcement
notes.content:
After years of development, we finally launched Fantasy Raiders Early Access on Steam!

[b]PLAY IT NOW![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32935014/e88a864c0367f81e89ee766f963dc7d499d6289d.jpg[/img]

For now, you can play with the whole contents described down below.

[h1]Explorer[/h1]

As an explorer, you can level up your player character up to level 70, and master 7 different types of skills up to level 5 for each:

[list]
[*] Sneak
[*] Pickpocket
[*] Close Combat
[*] Ranged Combat
[*] Fire Spell
[*] Frost Spell
[*] Trapping
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]

[list]
[*] Four different themes of regions to explore which has different visual for each one.
[*] Fifteen unique factions have its unique traits and behaviors.
[*] Four major factions which dynamically affected by the player's choices.
[*] More than 30 kinds of character models excluding variations.
[*] Three relics which has a different way to acquire, the way which is changed dynamically every time you attempt. And 40 types of treasures you can collect in anytime.
[*] Private warehouse (storeroom) where you can keep any of in-game 3D objects.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*] Each time of your play, you may encounter a new set of events in the open world of Fantasy Raiders.
[*] To gain experience faster, you may accept quests and obtain rewards from them.
[*] You may collect any treasure you can find in the world in your private warehouse, or you may gain rewards by delivering them to Explorers' Guild.
[*] You can track down the information of each region and NPCs to find the relics and collect them.
[*] Each of major factions reacts differently to the player character according to his/her reputation. As the character's friendship with each faction changes, you may find more or less difficult in completing quests or collecting treasures.
[/list]

[h1]Are you a streamer or contents creator?[/h1]

We're waiting for anyone who wants to broadcast the gameplay of Fantasy Raiders in live streaming! If you want to apply, please contact us at [b]contact@maverickgames.co[/b].

We feel appreciated for everyone who've been helped us to release the game. However, the journey of Fantasy Raiders has just begun. We're expecting you to enjoy the game and help us to improve the game with your feedback.

Thank you.

From the whole developers of Fantasy Raiders.

notes.title: Patch Notes on July 24
notes.content:
[u]Currently enrolled Beta players can download the updates automatically.[/u]

This patch includes gameplay statistics display and its optional report features, and major bug fixes.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[b]Now you can check the record of your exploration when you use the power of relics[/b]

Whenever you use the power of relics, you may check your play statistics in your exploration. If you collect all three relics and use them to activate its power, your gameplay statistics are going to be displayed since the end of the last activation of the relics. If it's your first time to use the power of relics, then it displays the statistics since the beginning of your gameplay.

[h1]List of Items for Player Statistics[/h1]

[list]
[*] Total Opened Chest Count
[*] Total Exhausted Count
[*] Total Kill Count
[*] Total Friendly Faction Count
[*] Total Intercepted Relic Count
[*] Total Friend Count
[*] Total Value of Pickpocketed Items
[*] Total Installed Trap Count
[*] Total Last Minute Saving Count
[*] Total Spread Fire Count
[*] Total Frozen Count
[/list]

[b]Fantasy Raiders asks you whether you will send the gameplay statistics on startup[/b]

Fantasy Raiders collects the player's input data and the result of a user's choices in-game. The collected information is going to be used only for the purposes of improving the gaming experience and fixing the bugs. The user profile information is encrypted and stored safely.

When you launch the game for the first time, we ask your consent whether you agree to send the information to Maverick Games or not. No matter of your choices, you can enjoy the full contents of the game.

You may optionally enable or disable the information collecting service anytime in the Setting menu later.

[b]You can now change your language in the Setting menu[/b]

Previously, the player could change language only on the Properties menu on Steam client. To support easy and faster language switching, we added the in-game menu so you can change the in-game language on the Setting menu.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] PC can't ever complete a specific quest even when he/she reach to the target room.
[*] Hostile NPCs resume attacking PC not showing any emoji on it after turning off a campfire.
[*] Completing the last "Destroy the sealed stone" quest doesn't unlock the Steam achievement.
[*] PC can earn searching points by revisiting a place where he/she already discovered.
[*] App crashes in the quest "Mysterious letter", and the game cannot be continued even after restarting the app.
[*] Treasure challenge fails when PC puts the treasure on warehouse (storeroom) to complete the challenge.
[*] Punching reaction animation doesn't play on click the PC.
[*] PC can't move across the destroyed fences.
[*] Sneak on animation doesn't play even after PC acquired Sneak skill level 3.
[*] Any emoji of an NPC isn't cleared when the same type of NPC appears on a different room in a row.
[*] NPC can't walk to the direction of the hostile character when it is surrounded by fences.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[b]PC can't attack with bow or cast spell on a torch behind the fences or a stone wall[/b]

Until we fix the bug, please approach to the target as closest as you can if the issue occurs. If it still doesn't solve your problem, you may rather destroy the obstacles (the fences or walls) by sword or trap explosion.

[b]PC can be trapped in obstacles after he/she moves to another room or he/she is pushed away by explosions[/b]

Sometimes, you can simply lift any obstacles you're having problem with, but it may be not a solution in some conditions. Until we solve the issue, in such case, please right click your character to open context menu, and select [b]Emergency Escape[/b] to solve the situation. (Because PC literally escapes the room and returns to the base camp, you may lose some of your progress).

notes.title: Patch Notes on July 13
notes.content:
[u]Currently enrolled Beta players can download the updates automatically.[/u]

This patch includes UI/UX improvements and bug fixes.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[b]Now you can open a context menu when the mouse is over on another context menu[/b]

Previously, the player had to cancel the current context menu to open another context menu because it wasn't able to open a context menu when the mouse is over on another.

Such behavior bothers the player's control and costs the player's time while the time is running when the context menu is closing. So here we fixed and improved the player interaction's behavior.

[b]Now you can use keyboard shortcuts to open main menu screens[/b]

Previously, to access a specific menu screen, you had to open the top-right main menu button and click the relevant menu icon which takes 2 or more steps for the access.

Now you can use keyboard shortcuts to access any main menu screens right away.


[h1]Global Shortcut List[/h1]

[list]
[*] Mailbox Screen: J
[*] Inventory Screen: I
[*] Equipment Screen: E
[*] Map Screen: M
[*] Skill Screen: S
[*] Setting Screen: X
[/list]

[b]Now you can press [i]Escape[/i] key to close a context menu, main menu screen, or relic screen[/b]

Previously, to close a context menu, main menu, or relic screen, there has been a different way to close each of them.

However, in our investigation, we found out that most of players press [i]Escape[/i] key before any behavior. So we added [i]Escape[/i] key which helps them to get the expected result immediately.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] PC delivers more damage when its Sneak level is four even when he/she's not in sneak mode.
[*] Passage between rooms disappear for unknown reasons so that PC can't move between rooms
[*] NPC slides on the ground without playing walk animation after unfrozen from any frost trap
[*] PC can't ever complete a specific quest because there's no quest target on target room
[*] PC's frost or fire magic doesn't get the result as expected when PC's in sneak mode
[*] PC can't pass through a disappeared object which is deactivated by a switch
[*] Ranged attacking NPC doesn't stop firing projectiles even when the time is stopped since the PC doesn't move
[*] Target location icon or complete location icon disappear when the map screen is opened more than once
[*] Some quest completion or success messages are missing in English version
[*] The quest "It's only a beginning" can't be completed
[*] When the target object is destroyed on the quest "It's only a beginning," the quest fail event isn't called so it can't be continued to play
[*] Some price and numbers are overlapping when the item description is too long
[*] When the player selling items bundling 5 or more items, the total cost is always equal to the price of one piece
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[b]You opened the relic screen since all the three relics are collected, but the collected relics are missing after you open the relic screen again since you close it[/b]

- Please take the screenshot of the relic screen with three relics before you close the screen.

[b]In the quest "Finders keepers, losers weepers," the Bullion disappear when the player drops it on the ground of the storeroom[/b]

- After you completed the quest, you MUST visit the next room before you throw it on the ground of the storeroom. We'll fix the issue for the coming updates.

notes.title: Fantasy Raiders' 2nd Beta is coming!

notes.title: Important note for Fantasy Raiders Beta testers
notes.content:
Hello, explorers!

We’re appreciated for your registration and participation to Fantasy Raiders Beta.

We’ve recently reported that the achievements of Fantasy Raiders in Steam aren’t visible to you. This is because the Fantasy Raiders isn’t released yet but in Coming Soon state in Steam community. For this reason, we decided to change the way to evaluate your achievements in Fantasy Raiders.

[b]Before[/b]

Set your Steam profile’s Game detail to public so your achievements are visible

[b]After[/b]

Take a screenshot for each game scene which can help us to verify that you did unlock each  achievements. For example,

[list]
    [*]The screenshot of your relic screen with three acquired relics.
    [*] The screenshot of any in-game mail screen which can prove that you completed the “Destroy the sealed stone” quest.
    [*] The screenshot of your skill screen so we can see that you’ve learned all of 7 major skills (Sneak, Pickpocket, Melee, Ranged, Fire, Frost, and Trap).

Save the screenshots in files, and send us mail with the attached screenshots to prove that you did unlock the achievements to fantasy-raiders-beta-test@maverickgames.co.

You don’t have to accomplish all of the tasks given. We’ll happily provide a free game key of Fantasy Raiders for each completed task in Early Access.
